summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed a Form 6-K reporting a September 17, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering of 10,000,000 Class A shares at $1.50 and 10,000,000 one-year warrants at $2.75, grossing $15,000,000 before fees. Univest Securities acted as placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis for a 7.0% cash fee plus up to $50,000 expenses. The offering closed September 18, 2026. Ten-day over-allotment option up to $15,000,000 and a zero-exercise-price feature permitting up to 90,000,000 shares create substantial dilution. Watch for warrant exercises and potential selling pressure on the underlying shares.
